exports.name: Pipe
signatures:
interface Pipe<M extends PipeEvents = PipeEvents> {
  readonly connecting: boolean
  readonly pending: boolean
  readonly readyState: 'open' | 'opening' | 'readOnly' | 'writeOnly' | 'closed'
  connect(path: string, opts?: PipeConnectOptions, onconnect?: () => void): this
  open(fd: number, opts?: PipeOpenOptions, onconnect?: () => void): this
  write(
    chunk: Buffer | string,
    encoding: BufferEncoding,
    handle?: IPCAcceptable,
    cb?: (err: Error | null) => void
  ): boolean
  accept<T extends IPCAcceptable>(target: T): T
  ref(): this
  unref(): this
  _open(cb: StreamCallback): void
  _predestroy(): void
  _destroy(err: Error | null, cb: StreamCallback): void
  readonly readable: boolean
  readonly writable: boolean
  readonly destroyed: boolean
  readonly destroying: boolean
  destroy(err?: Error | null): void
  _read(size: number): void
  readonly closed: boolean
  readonly errored: Error | null
  push(data: unknown | null, encoding?: BufferEncoding): boolean
  unshift(data: unknown | null, encoding?: BufferEncoding): boolean
  read(): unknown | null
  resume(): this
  pause(): this
  pipe<S extends Writable>(dest: S, cb?: StreamCallback): S
  setEncoding(encoding: BufferEncoding): void
  _write(data: unknown, encoding: StreamEncoding, cb: StreamCallback): void
  _writev(batch: { chunk: unknown; encoding: StreamEncoding }[], cb: StreamCallback): void
  _final(cb: StreamCallback): void
  end(cb?: StreamCallback): this
  cork(): void
  uncork(): void
}

members.name: Pipe
signatures: new Pipe(path: string | number, opts?: PipeOptions)
members.description:
Create a new pipe. If `path` is a number, it is treated as a file descriptor to open. If it is
a string, it is treated as a path to connect to.

params.name: path
params.description: A file descriptor to open (number), or a path to connect to (string).

params.name: opts
params.description:
Options; `readBufferSize` defaults to `65536`, `allowHalfOpen` and `eagerOpen` to
`true`, and `ipc` to `false` (set `ipc: true` to enable handle passing over the pipe).

members.name: accept
members.description:
Accept a pending handle into `target`. `target` must implement the
[`IPCAcceptable`](#ipcacceptable) protocol. Call this synchronously from the `'handle'` event
listener.

params.name: target
params.description:
The object to accept the pending handle into; must implement the
`IPCAcceptable` protocol. Call synchronously from the `'handle'` event listener.

returns.description: `target`, for chaining the accepted handle into an expression.

throws.condition: `target` does not implement the IPC handle protocol.

signatures: Pipe.createServer(opts?: PipeServerOptions, onconnection?: (pipe: Pipe) => void): PipeServer
members.description:
Create a new pipe server. The server extends
[`EventEmitter`](https://github.com/holepunchto/bare-events).

params.name: opts
params.description:
Options applied to each incoming pipe; `readBufferSize` defaults to `65536`,
`allowHalfOpen` to `true`, `pauseOnConnect` to `false`, and `ipc` to `false`.

params.name: onconnection
params.description: Called on each `'connection'` event.

returns.description: A `[read, write]` pair of file descriptors connected to each other.

`'closed'`.

signatures: write(chunk: Buffer | string, encoding: BufferEncoding, handle?: IPCAcceptable, cb?: (err: Error | null) => void): boolean
write(chunk: Buffer | string, encoding: BufferEncoding, cb?: (err: Error | null) => void): boolean
write(chunk: Buffer | string, handle?: IPCAcceptable, cb?: (err: Error | null) => void): boolean
write(chunk: Buffer | string, cb?: (err: Error | null) => void): boolean
members.description:
Write `chunk` to the pipe. If `handle` is given and the pipe was created with `ipc: true`, the
handle is transferred to the receiver alongside the chunk. `handle` must implement the
[`IPCAcceptable`](#ipcacceptable) protocol.

params.name: chunk
params.description: The data to write.

params.name: encoding
params.description: The encoding of `chunk` when it is a string.

params.name: handle
params.description:
A handle to transfer to the receiver alongside the chunk; requires the pipe to
have been created with `ipc: true` and `handle` to implement the `IPCAcceptable` protocol.

params.name: cb
params.description: Called when the chunk has been processed.
